name: Sleeping With The Sharkies
source:
Sir Oswald is a wealthy venture capitalist loan shark whom is invited to a party by Sir Reginald Fancy Fins along with several other gentlesharks however they quickly discover there is a kriller among them. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141212164234/http://ludumdare.com/compo/minild-46/?action=preview&uid=17183]Ludum Dare[/url]]
